decisive_items: numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics with a sparse lymphocytic infiltrate
non-erythematous, non-pitting edema of the left periorbital region
not improved with corticosteroid ophthalmic solutions or oral antihistamines
response.rationale: Lymphangioma best fits persistent unilateral periorbital swelling with biopsy-proven ectatic dermal lymphatics and vessels; angioedema would typically be episodic and antihistamine-responsive, and scleroderma would show fibrosis rather than vascular/lymphatic ectasia.

rejected.why: Angioedema is normally acute/episodic and antihistamine-responsive; the biopsy finding of ectatic lymphatics is not characteristic.
Scleroderma would manifest with dermal fibrosis and thickened collagen, not prominent ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics.
